Overview

San Antonio is a city in TX with a population of 1,479,862. Texas charm with the River Walk, historic missions, and no state income tax. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 9a growing zone supports Warm to hot — citrus, tropical fruits, year-round growing. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.6.
